theorem_title: Computing one physical band-record weighted score
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandWeightedScoreCell.meets {pMain pLength pScore : ℕ} (S : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightWeightedScore.Procs P pScore)
    (hmain : P[pMain]?=some (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandWeightedScoreCell.body pLength pScore))
    (hlength : P[pLength]?=some _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandWeightedScoreSlice.body)
    (primes : ℕ → ℕ) (r : _root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.Record)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hd : d+Nat.clog 2 maxMod+5 ≤ lim.depth)
    (hg : 0 < g) (hq : 0 < q) (hqmax : q ≤ maxMod)
    (ha : a+nA ≤ free) (hb : b+nB ≤ free) (hc : c+nC ≤ free)
    (hrec : rec+4 ≤ free) (haux : aux+s ≤ free)
    (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum.LightWeightedScore.space free maxMod g U ≤ lim.space)

    (hvalid : r.flag=1 → r.a*g ≤ nA ∧ r.b*g ≤ nB ∧ r.c*g ≤ nC)

      (fun result ν => result=(_root_.ThreeSum.BandWeightedScore.block primes s q nA nB nC g

theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let a stored four-cell band record have Boolean flag and, when enabled, valid band starts for three original arrays. Assume positive band size and current modulus, bounded original values, a stored injective prime family whose modulus products fit, and the full helper, layout, space, word, and depth bounds. The cell program returns the exact record-local weighted score and preserves memory below scratch, within its declared time.

This record-local score contract charges the current original owner bands rather than an unrelated global Cartesian product.
